welcome.text: Welcome to Hydris Field Glasses. Live plant data, alarms and guided rounds, hands free, right in your line of sight.

status-bar.text: Up top: your site, your connection, and anything waiting to sync.

home.text: Home is your shift at a glance, with your next task first.

readings.text: Live readings stream in from the plant, each one showing how fresh it is.

alarms.text: Alarms reach you the moment they trigger. Tap the alarm to open it.

alarm-detail.text: See the trigger value and the approved next step. Acknowledge tells the control room you are on it.

rounds.text: Rounds come from the console, and Hydris guides you step by step.

rounds-offline.text: Every reading is saved on the glasses, even with no signal, and syncs on its own.

sops.text: The SOP library holds only approved, current procedures.

scan.text: Audit scan turns a paper sheet into a verified, approved digital record.

voice.text: Just say Hey Hydris, and ask. Your hands stay on the job.

console-sees.text: Back in the control room, supervisors see your live view in real time.

closing.text: Hydris advises, and never controls equipment. Safer rounds, audit ready records. Have a safe shift.
